goals.title: Detect cancers before they become life-threatening and intercept in high-risk individuals
goals.opportunity: Blood-based screening, imaging sensitivity, and risk prediction models for early-onset cancers.
goals.rationale: Early detection is the single most important unsolved challenge in oncology.

goals.title: Identify modifiable risk factors, model accelerated biological aging, and develop prevention interventions
goals.opportunity: Vaccines and metabolic interventions that prevent tumor formation.
goals.rationale: Prevention is dramatically underdeveloped compared to treatment.

goals.title: Tailor therapy to each patient's tumor biology via genomic testing and molecular classification
goals.opportunity: Avoid unnecessary chemotherapy; predict treatment response with better biomarkers.
goals.rationale: Precision oncology is advancing but far from universal.

goals.title: Understand and overcome tumor resistance to immunotherapy and cell therapies
goals.opportunity: Make CAR-T/cell therapies safer and effective in solid tumors; map immunometabolic circuits.
goals.rationale: Resistance is one of the hardest problems in oncology.

goals.title: Block the molecular pathways that enable cancer spread
goals.opportunity: Model how metastatic cells survive in new environments and why some cancers spread early and silently.
goals.rationale: Metastasis is the #1 cause of cancer death.

goals.title: Model clonal diversity driving treatment failure and outcome uncertainty
goals.opportunity: Predict outcomes and design therapies robust to intra-tumor heterogeneity.
goals.rationale: Heterogeneity is a major barrier to durable cures.

goals.title: Reduce therapy harm while preserving efficacy
goals.opportunity: Safer CAR-T, fewer chemo side effects, better-tolerated ADCs.
goals.rationale: Balancing efficacy with quality of life is a persistent challenge.

goals.title: Accelerate discovery and diagnosis via integrated genomic, imaging, and clinical data
goals.opportunity: Reduce diagnostic errors and improve speed of care; the bottleneck is data quality and interoperability.
goals.rationale: The bottleneck is not technology — it's data quality and clinical adoption.

goals.title: Narrow unequal access to screening, advanced therapies, and clinical trials
goals.opportunity: Model and reduce racial, socioeconomic, and geographic outcome gaps.
goals.rationale: This is as much a systems problem as a scientific one.

goals.title: Convert 2026 breakthroughs into population-level survival gains
goals.opportunity: Adoption, affordability, and manufacturing scale for new therapies.
goals.rationale: The bench-to-bedside gap slows progress.

goals.title: Explain why some athletes develop and others stagnate
goals.opportunity: Multi-sport developmental engine modeling nonlinear growth, stress-response adaptation, phenotype drift, and co-development.
goals.rationale: Teams spend millions on development but operate with guesswork.

goals.title: Unified cross-sport data governance protocol
goals.opportunity: Standardize sensor/tracking/biometric data with quality, lineage, and validation into one decision layer.
goals.rationale: Teams have data but no truth system — build the first sports data OS.

goals.title: Predict fatigue thresholds, injury-risk windows, stress toxicity, and recovery half-life
goals.opportunity: Biotech-style load engine treating athletes as dynamic biological systems.
goals.rationale: Solves the #1 team problem: predicting collapse before it happens.

goals.title: Translate movement, contact, timing, and load patterns across NBA/NFL/boxing
goals.opportunity: Cross-sport biomechanics translator for transferable traits and training protocols.
goals.rationale: Unlocks new scouting, training, and athlete archetypes.

goals.title: Quantify cognitive fatigue, decision degradation, and reaction-time collapse
goals.opportunity: Neuro-decision load model for mental bandwidth and optimal decision windows.
goals.rationale: The missing half of performance science — the brain.

goals.title: Link biometrics, load, injury, and stress robustness to financial decisions
goals.opportunity: Performance-economics engine for contract risk, salary optimization, and roster construction.
goals.rationale: Front offices want science that directly impacts financial decisions.

goals.title: First full boxing analytics + biometrics platform
goals.opportunity: Punch-impact load, head-trauma accumulation, footwork efficiency maps, fatigue toxicity thresholds.
goals.rationale: Boxing is decades behind NBA/NFL — a completely open frontier.

goals.title: Cross-sport AI engine ingesting NBA/NFL/boxing data into universal performance laws
goals.opportunity: One model outputs sport-specific predictions from universal human performance laws.
goals.rationale: Becomes the GPT of sports science.

goals.title: Predict long-term durability, stress fragility, and career longevity
goals.opportunity: Durability genome mapping stress response, injury susceptibility, recovery phenotype.
goals.rationale: Directly impacts contracts, trades, and draft decisions.

goals.title: Establish a single source of truth across conflicting sport data sources
goals.opportunity: Resolve sensor conflict, tracking variance, and medical-protocol divergence.
goals.rationale: No standardized reality exists across NBA, NFL, and boxing.
